summary.text: Bo Whitehead is the Green Party candidate for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District and a first-time candidate who works as a warehouse supervisor.
According to WFAE, he moved to the Charlotte area about three years ago from Georgia.
He says he wants to represent the working class.

paragraphs.text: WFAE describes Whitehead as 33 years old and a warehouse supervisor who lived in Georgia before moving to the Charlotte area about three years ago; he lives in Pineville.
In a WFAE questionnaire he says he was homeschooled, received a GED, and holds prior CDL and Hazmat transport certifications.
He has no previous experience in elected office and says he is the primary caretaker for his wife.
